chunks: So We further strengthened his kingdom, and bestowed wisdom on him, and judgement in legal matters.
ai.seo_question: What specific gifts did God give to Prophet Sulaiman according to Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine origin of Sulaiman’s (AS) political power, linking it directly to his spiritual wisdom (Hikmah) and eloquent judgment (Fasl al-Khitab). It serves as a paradigm for the ideal ruler, where temporal authority is validated by the capacity to discern truth and administer justice with clarity.
